title: SCA Minhag of the Week 279: "Birkat Kohanim in Shahrit on Tish'a BeAb"

chapters.title: Birkat Kohanim on Tish'a BeAb Morning
chapters.about: Introduction to the minhag not to do Birkat Kohanim in Shahrit.

chapters.title: Influence from Yerushalayim
chapters.about: The difference in minhag in Yerushalayim and recent changes in minyanim.

chapters.title: Reasoning Behind Our Minhag
chapters.about: Likening the community to a mourner and the lack of shalom.

chapters.title: Sources Among the Hakhamim
chapters.about: Shulchan Aruch, Tanya Bati, David Abudraham, and Haham Chaim Ber Benisti.

chapters.title: Pesukim and Sinat Chinam
chapters.about: The pesuk in Yeshayahu and the issue of sinat chinam.

chapters.title: Community Prayer Books and Ben Ish Hai
chapters.about: Evidence from various community prayer books and the ruling of Ben Ish Hai.

summary: Mr. Mosseri explains the community custom regarding Birkat Kohanim during Shahrit on Tish'a BeAb. He reviews the reasons given by various Hakhamim against doing it in the morning and notes that community prayer books support maintaining this custom.
questions: Do we do Birkat Kohanim on Tish'a BeAb morning?
Why do some minyanim in our community do Birkat Kohanim on Tish'a BeAb Shaharit?
What is the reasoning behind not doing Birkat Kohanim on Tish'a BeAb morning?
What do community prayer books indicate about Birkat Kohanim on Tish'a BeAb?
What did the Ben Ish Hai rule regarding Birkat Kohanim on Tish'a BeAb?
